description:
Fetch time-series observations for a single StatCan vector via SDMX REST.

Simpler alternative to get_sdmx_data when you already know the vectorId.
Use get_series_info (productId + coordinate) to find vectorIds.

Time filtering (use one or the other, not both):
  lastNObservations=5   → last 5 periods
  startPeriod="2020-01" → from Jan 2020 (monthly); "2020" for annual
  endPeriod="2023-12"   → up to Dec 2023

LIMITATION: StatCan rejects combining lastNObservations with startPeriod/endPeriod (returns 406).

Output has the same shape as get_sdmx_data: one entry in "series" with its
constant fields once, then "observations" as [period, value] pairs. Over 100
observations it is a summary (latest, min, max) unless full=true.

Growth, percent change or averages? Use query_sdmx instead of computing by hand.

IMPORTANT: In your final response to the user, you MUST cite the source of your data.
This means including the _sdmx_url and vectorId in your response.

endPeriod.description: End period in YYYY or YYYY-MM format.
endPeriod.title: Endperiod

full.description: Return every observation (max 500). Default: results over 100 observations come back as a per-series summary (latest, min, max, period range).
full.title: Full

lastNObservations.description: Return only the last N observations (e.g. 5 for last 5 periods).
lastNObservations.title: Lastnobservations

startPeriod.description: Start period in YYYY or YYYY-MM format.
startPeriod.title: Startperiod

name: get_sdmx_vector_data

SDMXSeries.description: One series: its constant fields (dimension labels, VECTOR_ID, UOM, ...) once.

_series_key.description: Dot-separated SDMX key of this series.
_series_key.title: Series Key

observations.description: [period, value] pairs; value is a number or null (suppressed). Observations with their own attributes add a third element {field: label}.
observations.title: Observations

SDMXSeries.title: SDMXSeries

_sdmx_url.description: SDMX request URL — cite as the data source.
_sdmx_url.title: Sdmx Url

_truncated.description: True if observations were capped at 500.
_truncated.title: Truncated

row_count.description: Total observations returned by StatCan (before truncation).
row_count.title: Row Count
